sections.heading: Simple by default, with room to take control
sections.content: Creators use the tool to automate Facebook advertising, with Eventbrite’s data helping improve results. For creators who just want marketing handled, the default takes care of targeting and creative. For those who want to optimize audience segments or ad creative themselves, the interface provides an on-ramp to more sophisticated controls. Casey said this gave both kinds of users an easy path to success, though Eventbrite had not perfected the approach.

sections.heading: The broader design principle
sections.content: Casey describes the aspiration as “perceived simplicity”: advanced features should be easy to discover when someone looks for them, but effectively hidden from people who do not need them, so complexity does not make the product harder for the majority. He also noted that creator sophistication varies and can change over time, making a single segmentation approach less effective in the broader Eventbrite product.
